svg.title: The last circle is almost a line
svg.desc: The final higher meeting on the whole 11 / 6 outward leg is a negative reflected pair at distance about 16172.76506. This drawing shows the member above the mirror axis. On the left, three colored visits of the original curve touch a very large circle, whose visible arc looks almost straight. Short dashed arrows point toward the distant center. On the right, the complete same circle makes the entire original drawing look tiny near its lower edge. Both views use equal horizontal and vertical scales, at different magnifications. The complete census proves no higher meeting at any distance at least 16173.

g.text: The last circle is almost a line.
The final reflected pair on 11 / 6 occurs at M ≈ 16,172.76506.
The three marked visits touch this circle tangentially.
Dashed arrows on the left point toward the distant center. Moving one full radius brings all three visits there.
Equal horizontal and vertical scales within each view · different magnifications · no higher meeting for M ≥ 16,173
